What the panel asked for

Two things, and they pull in opposite directions — keep one button, remove another.

Keep

Manual enrollment

The team cannot test the system without it. The form is unchanged and still collects Last Name, First Name, Middle Name, Username, Password and Section — one student at a time, no CSV file required.

Remove

Download CSV Template

Gone from the Student Enrollment card. The Registrar supplies the official class list, so a template MindSpark hands out was only competing with it. The column names it documented now sit inline above the upload button.

Why bulk enrollment failed

Not a bug in the upload. The database on the server was a version behind the code, and the error message hid that completely.

  1. The August migration was never applied to the live server 2026-08-revision.sql adds last_name, first_name and middle_name to the users table. It ran on the local machine only.
  2. Every student row hit a column that wasn’t there MySQL answered ER_BAD_FIELD_ERROR — unknown column — on the first insert and on all the rest.
  3. The route replaced that with a message that explained nothing The catch block returned a fixed string, so the real reason never reached the screen. Two testing attempts were spent on it.
What the teacher saw Bulk enrollment failed
What it now says The database is out of date — apply database/migrations/ (latest: 2026-08b-revision.sql) to this server, then try again.

The translation lives in lib/db.ts, which every database call in the project already passes through — so the single-student form, which had no error handling at all, reports the same way now instead of throwing a blank 500.

Before the school can test

The code is pushed. These three run on the server and need credentials only the team has — in this order.

  1. 1
    Apply the three migrations to the live database 2026-06-revision.sql, then 2026-08-revision.sql, then 2026-08b-revision.sql. This alone is what broke bulk enrollment.
  2. 2
    Reseed the question bank database/seed-questions.sql — 500 questions, 50 normal and 50 boss per level.
  3. 3
    Deploy the web build The Android app loads the same web URL, so once the site is updated the app follows without a new APK.
